name: TOTP Disable Success
summary: An authenticated user with TOTP enabled explicitly chooses to disable the authenticator, confirms the destructive action, and removes the enrolled authenticator and recovery-code material from the current durable identity.
finalOutcome: TOTP is disabled for the current durable identity, authenticator and recovery-code secrets are removed, and the user remains signed in as the same durable identity.

sourceReferences.note: DisableMfaAsync removes authenticator and recovery-code secrets, clears TOTP replay/last-MFA state, and sets TwoFactorEnabled false. ResetMfaAsync currently delegates directly to the same operation.
Reset is not exposed as a separate user-facing behavior while its server semantics are identical to Disable.

Authored test design has started. Server proof must exercise the real MFA manager through a normalized authentication flow/handler path and prove secret removal, TwoFactorEnabled false, replay/last-MFA reset, canonical transition evidence, and TotpDisableMfaStart/TotpDisableMfaSuccess events. Runtime setup must be able to establish real TOTP secret and recovery-code material before this behavior can be independently executed.
